#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> multiply(const vector<int>& p1, const vector<int>& p2, int mod) {
    int len = p1.size() + p2.size() - 1;
    int size = 1;
    while (size < len) size <<= 1;
    
    vector<double> re1(size, 0.0), im1(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)p1.size(); i++) {
        long long v = ((long long)p1[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        re1[i] = v & 0x7FFF;
        im1[i] = v >> 15;
    }
    
    vector<double> re2(size, 0.0), im2(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)p2.size(); i++) {
        long long v = ((long long)p2[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        re2[i] = v & 0x7FFF;
        im2[i] = v >> 15;
    }
    
    // FFT for re1, im1
    int n = size;
    int bits = 0;
    while ((1 << bits) < n) bits++;
    vector<int> rev(n, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        rev[i] = (rev[i >> 1] >> 1) | ((i & 1) << (bits - 1));
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (i < rev[i]) {
            swap(re1[i], re1[rev[i]]);
            swap(im1[i], im1[rev[i]]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int half = len >> 1;
        vector<double> cosTab(half), sinTab(half);
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            double angle = -2 * M_PI * i / len;
            cosTab[i] = cos(angle);
            sinTab[i] = sin(angle);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                double wR = cosTab[j];
                double wI = sinTab[j];
                double uR = re1[i + j];
                double uI = im1[i + j];
                double vR = re1[i + j + half] * wR - im1[i + j + half] * wI;
                double vI = re1[i + j + half] * wI + im1[i + j + half] * wR;
                
                re1[i + j] = uR + vR;
                im1[i + j] = uI + vI;
                re1[i + j + half] = uR - vR;
                im1[i + j + half] = uI - vI;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // FFT for re2, im2
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (i < rev[i]) {
            swap(re2[i], re2[rev[i]]);
            swap(im2[i], im2[rev[i]]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int half = len >> 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                double wR = cosTab[j];
                double wI = sinTab[j];
                double uR = re2[i + j];
                double uI = im2[i + j];
                double vR = re2[i + j + half] * wR - im2[i + j + half] * wI;
                double vI = re2[i + j + half] * wI + im2[i + j + half] * wR;
                
                re2[i + j] = uR + vR;
                im2[i + j] = uI + vI;
                re2[i + j + half] = uR - vR;
                im2[i + j + half] = uI - vI;
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<double> resRe(size, 0.0), resIm(size, 0.0);
    vector<double> tmpRe(size, 0.0), tmpIm(size, 0.0);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
        
        double a1r = (re1[i] + re1[j]) * 0.5;
        double a1i = (im1[i] - im1[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2r = (im1[i] + im1[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2i = (re1[j] - re1[i]) * 0.5;
        
        double b1r = (re2[i] + re2[j]) * 0.5;
        double b1i = (im2[i] - im2[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (im2[i] + im2[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (re2[j] - re2[i]) * 0.5;
        
        resRe[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        resIm[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        tmpRe[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        tmpIm[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }
    
    // Inverse FFT for resRe, resIm
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (i < rev[i]) {
            swap(resRe[i], resRe[rev[i]]);
            swap(resIm[i], resIm[rev[i]]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int half = len >> 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                double wR = cosTab[j];
                double wI = sinTab[j];
                double uR = resRe[i + j];
                double uI = resIm[i + j];
                double vR = resRe[i + j + half] * wR - resIm[i + j + half] * wI;
                double vI = resRe[i + j + half] * wI + resIm[i + j + half] * wR;
                
                resRe[i + j] = uR + vR;
                resIm[i + j] = uI + vI;
                resRe[i + j + half] = uR - vR;
                resIm[i + j + half] = uI - vI;
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        resRe[i] /= n;
        resIm[i] /= n;
    }
    
    // Inverse FFT for tmpRe, tmpIm
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (i < rev[i]) {
            swap(tmpRe[i], tmpRe[rev[i]]);
            swap(tmpIm[i], tmpIm[rev[i]]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int half = len >> 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                double wR = cosTab[j];
                double wI = sinTab[j];
                double uR = tmpRe[i + j];
                double uI = tmpIm[i + j];
                double vR = tmpRe[i + j + half] * wR - tmpIm[i + j + half] * wI;
                double vI = tmpRe[i + j + half] * wI + tmpIm[i + j + half] * wR;
                
                tmpRe[i + j] = uR + vR;
                tmpIm[i + j] = uI + vI;
                tmpRe[i + j + half] = uR - vR;
                tmpIm[i + j + half] = uI - vI;
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        tmpRe[i] /= n;
        tmpIm[i] /= n;
    }
    
    vector<int> out(len, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        long long aa = llround(resRe[i]);
        long long bb = llround(tmpRe[i]);
        long long cc = llround(resIm[i]);
        out[i] = (int)((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return out;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    
    vector<int> basePoly(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int idx;
        cin >> idx;
        basePoly[idx] = 1;
    }
    
    vector<int> result = {1};
    int exp = n / 2;
    
    while (true) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            result = multiply(result, basePoly, MOD);
        }
        exp >>= 1;
        if (exp == 0) break;
        basePoly = multiply(basePoly, basePoly, MOD);
    }
    
    long long total = 0;
    for (int val : result) {
        total = (total + (long long)val * val) % MOD;
    }
    cout << total << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
